zh: 悬浮球：跨 app 真悬浮球，拖动贴边、点击展开快捷面板（录制概要 + 去记录/去监控）
前台探测：抖音等平台前台时悬浮球高亮平台色，面板显示 Cookie 健康状态，一键探测直播间
自定义录制目录：可选任意文件夹（含 SD 卡），新录制直接落盘所选目录
记录页：平台筛选 + 排序/筛选记忆 + 动画；监控卡片紧凑模式；Cookie 网页登录获取
更新体验：设置页手动检查更新 + 应用内下载安装
修复：录制记录漏入库（失败/中断也留痕）、改名平台 Cookie 失效判定不生效
en: Floating ball: true cross-app overlay, draggable with edge snap and quick panel
Foreground detection: ball highlights platform color, shows cookie health, one-tap probe
Custom record directory: pick any folder (SAF/all-files access) for new recordings
Records page: platform filter + persistent filters + animations; compact monitor cards
Cookie web login helper for all major platforms; in-app update check & install
Fixes: missing record entries, stale cookie-expiry detection for renamed platforms
